description: Litigation, legal proceedings, and regulatory enforcement language in SEC filings. Structured for merge with user-supplied custom dictionaries (Pro).

entries.note: Active or pending lawsuit or legal dispute — elevated liability risk
Active or pending legal action against or involving the company
Formal disclosure category for pending or threatened legal matters
Formal legal challenge initiated or threatened against the company
Multiple formal legal challenges initiated or threatened
Disputed factual claim not yet adjudicated — legal uncertainty present
Disputed factual claim not yet adjudicated
Multiple disputed factual claims not yet adjudicated
Party initiating legal action against the company
Party defending against legal action — indicates named in suit
Collective lawsuit — elevated and potentially material liability exposure
Formal out-of-court dispute resolution proceeding
Government agency enforcement or investigation — compliance risk
Government agency enforcement proceeding — regulatory risk
Federal or state investigation — elevated regulatory and legal risk
Formal inquiry by regulatory agency — compliance and enforcement risk
Criminal probe — elevated risk, potential for criminal liability
Securities and Exchange Commission inquiry — disclosure and enforcement risk
Department of Justice inquiry — elevated criminal and civil risk
Court order constraining company operations or specific activities
Compelled legal production of documents or testimony
Criminal charge formally filed — highest-severity legal signal
Alleged violation of securities laws — material disclosure risk
Adverse court ruling against the company or its position
Adverse court ruling — potential material financial impact
Qualifier indicating significant negative legal or financial impact
Claim for financial compensation — quantified liability exposure
Punitive liability claim — significantly elevated financial exposure
Court-ordered settlement constraining future conduct
Order or demand to stop specific business activities
